== Biography ==
Ralph was born about 1809. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1530|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Brash-171|Margaret Brash]].  He passed away in 1887. 

In this household, Ralph Glasgow, aged 42 and born in 1809, was the head. He worked as a hand loom weaver silk and hailed from Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Scotland. His wife, Agnes Glasgow, aged 45 and born in 1806, shared the household. Ralph and Agnes had three children: a 15-year-old unmarried son named Ralph who worked as an errand boy, a 13-year-old son named Alexander who also worked as an errand boy, and an 11-year-old daughter named Margaret who was a scholar. Additionally, Janet, aged 7 and born in 1844, was another daughter and a scholar. The record offers insights into the family's ages, relationships, occupations, and educational statuses at that time.
